principles: Fix the test fixture, not the production gate: the gate correctly calls readReviewRuns; the stub was incomplete.
Mirror the existing correct stub (review-incremental-context-smoke) for consistency.
Minimal blast radius: one stub method; the rest of the smoke unchanged.
Verification is restoration: full npm test returns to green.
drivers: A RED full npm test on main blocks every story honest full-test claim and CI.
Only docs-drift-wrapper-root-smoke hits the gate without the method (siblings audited).
The production gate is correct and must not be weakened to accommodate an incomplete stub.

options.name: add-stub-method
pros: Matches the real StoryStore contract the gate expects.
cons: Must keep stub stores in sync with future gate reads (inherent to hand-rolled stubs).

options.name: make-readReviewRuns-optional-in-gate
cons: Production change to accommodate a test stub; weakens the gate; wrong layer.

options.name: remove-smoke-from-npm-test-chain
cons: Hides real docs-drift wrapper-root coverage; regression masked, not fixed.

rationale: The production preflight gate correctly reads store.readReviewRuns; the docs-drift stub simply omits it. Adding readReviewRuns: () => ({ runs: [] }) (mirroring review-incremental-context-smoke) is the minimal, test-only fix that restores npm test to green without weakening the gate or hiding coverage.

preMortem.scenario: readReviewRuns returns the wrong shape and the gate still throws/misbehaves.
preMortem.mitigation: Return { runs: [] } to match collectReviewerEvidenceState reading .runs; mirror review-incremental-context-smoke; verify by running the smoke + full npm test.

preMortem.scenario: Another stub store has the same gap and full npm test still fails elsewhere.
preMortem.trigger: Only fixing docs-drift while a sibling also hits the gate.
preMortem.consequence: npm test red at a different step.
preMortem.mitigation: Siblings already audited (review-incremental-context has it; review-convergence/authority-enforce-matrix do not hit the gate); the verification is full npm test green end-to-end.

preMortem.scenario: The edit accidentally changes other stub behavior and perturbs the docs-drift assertions.
preMortem.trigger: Editing beyond the single added method.
preMortem.consequence: docs-drift smoke fails on an unrelated assertion.
preMortem.mitigation: Add ONLY the readReviewRuns property; leave every other stub field byte-identical; run the smoke to confirm its own checks still pass.
